en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a narrow canal running between dense rows of old town buildings. Wooden structures and small jetties extend over the water, where several people stand or work along the canal edge. The top text identifies the scene as Kolberg and the Mühlenkanal, nicknamed 'Kolberger Venedig'. At the bottom, a red imprint credits the publisher and place, dated 1887.
